queries: WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, order_count, order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, order_count::numeric / AVG(order_count) OVER () AS count_to_average FROM scope_counts ORDER BY acctscope

assumptions.assumption: Each matched order counts once per scope even if several risk/margin records reference it. The average covers scopes present in the matched results; a NULL scope forms a group if present.

alternatives.interpretation: Count each matching risk/margin record–order pair, so an order with several risk/margin records contributes several times.
alternatives.sql: WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, match_count, match_count::numeric / SUM(match_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, match_count::numeric / AVG(match_count) OVER () AS count_to_average FROM scope_counts ORDER BY acctscope

alternatives.interpretation: Include orders with NULL acctscope as a separate group in the counts and total.
